title: End To Ender
description: I never understood why it was "the end portal" or "end stone" while we also have "EndERmen" "EndER chests" and "EndERmites" so i changed some stuff to make it more consistent. Anything that originates from the end has been changed to "Ender"
body:
End To Ender literally just replaces most things which have "**End**" to make 'em "**Ender**" for consistency.
Currently, this is for _**American English**_, though I might upload multiple versions !

Nothing else to say... uh enjoy!
